SELECT (fish_date_doy/10)*10 AS doy_bucket, cls,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS ang,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS rate,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','full_day')
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 250 AND 320
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT fish_date_doy AS doy, cls,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS ang,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS rate,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','full_day')
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 240 AND 320 AND cls='three_quarter'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1
